title: Secure observability relay Terraform module for VPC: sidecar log relay, mTLS cert rotation, and safe in-place upgrades
creator: Sofia Reed
description: Build a reusable Terraform module for private VPC deployments that installs and manages a secure observability stack: Prometheus + Grafana + OpenTelemetry Collector + a sidecar log-relay. Goals: 1) provide an opinionated, policy-driven module for log/metric/tracing shipping that enforces mTLS between services and collectors; 2) integrate certificate rotation using HashiCorp Vault PKI and Terraform-native rotation hooks; 3) support non-disruptive upgrades with blue/green or shadow canary patterns in-place (no destructive resource replacement by default); 4) emit health probes and SLO-driven readiness checks so the Redwood deployment controller can reconcile and rollback on regressions.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Module deploys in a VPC with minimal inputs (VPC id, subnets, iam roles) and provisions Prometheus/Grafana and an OTEL collector with secure endpoints. 2) Sidecar log-relay (Vector) is deployed as a Terraform-managed DaemonSet or ECS sidecar depending on runtime and is configured to use mTLS with certs issued by Vault. 3) Certificate rotation is automated: Terraform triggers short-lived cert issuance and rotates secrets in-place without downtime for readers. 4) Module exposes outputs for router policies so a Deployment Controller can switch traffic to a canary instance and roll back if health checks fail. 5) Upgrade path documented with a migration plan and a dry-run flag for Terraform plan evaluation.
design_decisions: - Use Vector as the log-relay sidecar: smaller runtime and fewer dependencies than fluentd; native support for structured transforms. - Use HashiCorp Vault PKI for cert issuance and short TTLs; Terraform will manage roles and templated certs via vault provider. - Avoid immutable resource replacement: prefer in-place updates and lifecycle ignore_changes for ephemeral fields where necessary. - Canary strategy implemented via duplicated service sets and a service mesh traffic-splitting annotation; fallback to DNS routing when mesh not present. - OTEL collector configured to accept mTLS only and marshal to internal metric/log store via secure backends (S3/Vector/Prometheus remote_write as configured).
risks_and_mitigation: - Risk: Vault outage during rotation could block cert renewal. Mitigation: graceful fallback using existing certs until Vault recovers; alerting when TTL < 10% remaining. - Risk: Terraform plan surprises on provider changes during upgrades. Mitigation: preflight 'dry-run' plan evaluation and a documented upgrade checklist; run canary before global rollout. - Risk: Sidecar forwarding introduces CPU/memory pressure on node. Mitigation: resource requests/limits, autoscaler tuning guidance, and an optional central relay aggregator mode.
implementation_notes: - Module will include multiple submodules: prometheus, grafana, otel_collector, log_relay, vault_integration, and canary_controller. Each submodule exposes minimal, consistent inputs. - Provide example overlays for EKS (Helm charts with values managed by terraform) and ECS/Fargate (task definitions). - Use terraform-provider-vault for PKI roles and templates instead of embedding cert material in state. - Provide a 'health_probe' output that the Console can scrape to show module readiness and the 'canary_endpoint' to direct a percentage of traffic. - Include automated tests: terratest for EKS overlay and policy tests for Vault role permissions.
comments: 2026-01-12 - Triage: Scoped module and assigned to Ethan. Initial owner sign-off from Platform PM (Ava Park).

2026-01-18 - Design review: Presented in infra sync. Feedback: add a fallback network policy for clusters without service mesh; tighten Vault role permissions (least privilege). Action: update design doc.

2026-01-22 - Implementation started: scaffolding submodules and adding terraform tests. Added example eks/ and ecs/ overlays in repo. (github: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-obs-modules/pull/42)

2026-01-28 - Infra review: Security requested rotation hooks use non-blocking apply patterns; reworked cert rotation to use external short-lived certs and K8s secret sync job. Added docs for Vault high-availability assumptions.

2026-02-02 - Canary trial: Deployed module to staging VPC with 10% traffic split to canary; observed increased CPU from Vector on two nodes. Next actions: tune resource limits and add sample transforms to drop high-cardinality fields.
2026-02-04 - QA: Added terratest for EKS overlay; created runbook for upgrade rollback and manual intervention steps. Ready to open RFC for rollout plan.
